issues.description: The proof removes `external_body` by decomposing the original one-line `page_size` execution into new executable locals and a temporary result instead of keeping all proof scaffolding in proof mode.
issues.rationale: The base implementation returns `PAGE_SIZE << (nr_subpage_per_huge::<PagingConsts>().ilog2() as usize * (level as usize - 1))` directly. The reviewed revision removes `external_body`, but also changes executable structure by computing `index_bits`, `level_index`, `shift`, and `ret` outside proof blocks. These locals are not required for runtime behavior; they exist to name expressions used by the proof. The collaborator reviewer explicitly requests keeping the original source expression and moving all definitions into a proof block. The final `Keep page_size exec body unchanged` commit does exactly that and then receives approval. This violates the same-head hard constraint to avoid changing executable Rust for verification work unless required and to keep proof edits minimal, captured as `preserve-exec-code`.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Compared the fixed base, reviewed merge commit, final approved head, complete archived/live discussion, and the same-head executable-code constraint.
